_note: Copied unchanged from TINProject tools/nkido_pipeline/analysis_targets.json (stem thresholds). A missing key means the limit is ON. Only the exception lists below are flesh-pit specific; each is named and explained, nothing is silently widened.

stem._rhythmic_ok_note: Named intentional rhythms only. Chewing (2.5 Hz bite) is a beat by definition, like TINProject's drum stems. chew_strain is one laboured breath per 2 s. amb_heart_a/b are the body's heartbeat, the same class as TINProject amb_pulse which the owner confirmed as an intended beat (2026-09-29). The drone beds amb_body_a/b and amb_restroom are NOT exempt and must pass; their irregular life (digestion, creaks) is played as random one-shots by the kit instead of being baked into a loop.
stem._mono_ok_note: Mouth and throat sounds sit dead centre inside the head; the heart is a sub layer and a wide sub only smears the centre (TINProject amb_pressure/amb_pulse precedent).

variation._note: Same limits as TINProject render_variations.py. Level spread is measured on the RAW renders before mastering, so normalising cannot hide it.

masking._note: Same limit as TINProject event_bed_pairs.json, judged on own_energy_weighted_margin_db, with each file at its mastered level and in-game volume.

_sfx_note: One-shots are mono and do not loop, so loop-wrap / width / correlation / hidden-loop checks do not describe them. TINProject also gates only stems with these; its events get masking only. Everything else (category LUFS, clipping, true peak, DC, low band, silence) applies to sfx.
